name: Atoner's Grace
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Disarming Mien.

A creature's Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile attitude doesn't impose Disadvantage|XPHB on your Charisma (Persuasion) checks to influence that creature.

Parley.

When you take the Disengage or Influence action, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you has Advantage|XPHB on the next ability check or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

name: Boon of the Bandit King
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Dastardly Charm.

You have Advantage|XPHB on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks to pick a pocket. When you succeed on such a check, you can cause the target of your theft to willingly part with the item and have the Charmed condition for 1 minute or until it takes damage. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Uncatchable.

You don't provoke Opportunity Attack when you move out of a creature's reach.

name: Boon of the Cleansed Heart
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Cleanse Heart.

You can cast Dispel Evil and Good without expending a spell slot. You can't use the spell's Dismissal special function when you cast it in this way.

Radiant Reflection.

You have Immunity|XPHB to Necrotic damage. When you would be subjected to Necrotic damage and don't have the Incapacitated condition, you can deal 2d8 Radiant damage to each creature of your choice within a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from yourself.

name: Boon of the Hunter's Eye
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Quick Capture.

When you deal damage to a creature you intend to knock out rather than kill, if the target has 20 or fewer Hit Points|XPHB after your damage is dealt, the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB instead.

Studied Hunter.

When you roll Initiative|XPHB, you can choose a creature you can see; you know whether that creature has any Immunity|XPHB|Immunities, Resistance|XPHB|Resistances, or Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

name: Boon of Unwavering Devotion
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Possession Immunity.

You automatically succeed on saving throws to avoid or end possession.

See Through Illusions.

Visual illusions appear transparent to you, and you automatically succeed on saving throws against them.

Undeniable Confidence.

Immediately after a creature you can see succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw against an effect you created, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to force that creature to reroll the save, and it must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative|XPHB or finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Raised by Cultists
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Bloody Revelation.

When you become Bloodied|XPHB, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to gain Heroic Inspiration|XPHB.

Communal Caster.

When an ally within 5 feet of you makes a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration|XPHB, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to give your ally Advantage|XPHB on the save.

name: Trapper
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Eye for Detail.

You have Advantage|XPHB on any Intelligence (Investigation) check you make as part of the Study action.

Swift Tracker.

You don't have Disadvantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks while traveling at a Travel Pace, and you have Advantage|XPHB on such checks while traveling at a Travel Pace.

Trap Expert.

You can take a Bonus Action|XPHB, instead of a Utilize action, to set a Hunting Trap. When you set a Hunting Trap, you add your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus to the DC of the saving throw to avoid the trap and the DC of the check to escape it.

name: Underhanded
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Elusive.

Immediately after you roll Initiative|XPHB, you can move up to 10 feet.

Fight Dirty.

When a creature one size larger than you or smaller makes an Opportunity Attack against you and misses, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to give that creature the Prone condition. You must have a free hand to use this Reaction|XPHB.
